# Will Cook's public websites

> A small entry point for agents researching the public Plectis projects. The current project introduction is https://wcook04.github.io/plectis/; this host-root homepage is retained legacy material.

## Start here

- [Project directory](https://wcook04.github.io/agent-guide.md): choose a website, follow its data files to the original source, and retain the stated result and its limits.
- [Plectis](https://wcook04.github.io/plectis/llms.txt): mathematical research, papers, the toolkit, maps of papers, proof statements and programs, with labelled relationships.
- [Plectis Atlas](https://wcook04.github.io/plectis-atlas/llms.txt): an independent reader for OpenAI's mathematics release, a map of related papers and comments credited to outside readers.
- [Plectis Zenith](https://wcook04.github.io/plectis-zenith/llms.txt): experiments that investigate software and repair errors, with recorded results and graphs of the programs' dependencies.

## Compatibility

- [Retained root reading map](https://wcook04.github.io/data/absolute-frontier.json): historical snapshot with source hashes, paper URLs and problem URLs. Use each project's current entry above for current claims.
- [Microcosm compatibility map](https://wcook04.github.io/microcosm-substrate/legacy-route-manifest.json): old website addresses now point to Plectis; Microcosm was the project's earlier name.
